HELPERHUB.AutoHint: Play the selected transition when switching to a scene that has no transition type of its own.
HELPERHUB.ForceHint: Use the selected transition even when the scene already has a transition type. Automatic mode must also be enabled.
HELPERHUB.DurationHint: Duration, in milliseconds, used when this module injects a scene transition.
HELPERHUB.IntensityHint: Shared strength from zero to one. TV static: interference. Smoke: density and drift. Spinner: arc thickness and glow. Whip pan: blur and letterbox height. Custom mask: edge softness.
HELPERHUB.VolumeHint: Volume of the synthesized static hiss. Zero mutes it. Multiplied by the global ambient volume. Plays only during the TV static transition.
HELPERHUB.TransitionHint: Transition played when this module injects a scene change. The list includes the effects added here and the core scene transitions.
HELPERHUB.CustomFileHint: Image or video for the Custom Animation transition. Videos can be mp4, webm, ogv, or m4v. GIF and APNG do not play frame by frame; upload a video instead. Mask mode uses the brightness of the frame: dark keeps the old scene and light reveals the new one.
HELPERHUB.CustomModeHint: Play shows the file over the scene change. Mask uses its brightness to reveal the new scene.
HELPERHUB.CombatVitalsHint: Show each combatant's hit points, an amount, damage and healing, and a status-effect button on the combat tracker. Only the GM sees these controls.
HELPERHUB.CustomMissing: The custom transition file is missing or cannot be played. The scene will fade instead.
HELPERHUB.ChatImagesHint: Upload image files dropped onto the chat log and post them as a message.
HELPERHUB.ChatLinksHint: Turn an image or YouTube link pasted or dropped into chat into a card.
HELPERHUB.PlaylistYouTubeHint: Allow YouTube links to be added to playlists and played in place of the silent placeholder.
HELPERHUB.DropNotImage: Only image files can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.DropNoPermission: You do not have permission to upload files.
HELPERHUB.DropPostFailed: The images uploaded, but the chat message could not be posted.
HELPERHUB.LinkPostFailed: The link could not be posted to chat.
HELPERHUB.DropBusy: An image upload is already in progress.
HELPERHUB.DropUrlUnsupported: Only an image or YouTube link can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.PlaylistNotYouTube: That link is not a YouTube video.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorsHint: Right-click an image posted by this module to create a D&D 5e NPC from a Plutonium bestiary creature. The action is shown only while Plutonium is active and the user can create actors.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorBestiaryFailed: The bestiary could not be loaded.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorImportFailed: The creature could not be imported.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorImageFailed: The image could not be saved.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorBadImage: That image cannot be used as a portrait.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorCreateFailed: The character could not be created.
HELPERHUB.ChatActorPortraitFailed: The character was created, but the chat image could not be applied.
HELPERHUB.TokenFrameFailed: The token frame could not be applied.
HELPERHUB.TokenFramePlaceHint: Drag to move the portrait. The slider zooms.
HELPERHUB.TokenFrameFitFailed: The portrait could not be fitted inside the ring. The colored ring was still applied.
HELPERHUB.JournalPinsHint: Show a journal-page action in the page menu, an icon dialog when a page is dropped on the scene, and a preview when hovering a note that points at a page. The menu, the drop dialog, and the hover preview turn off together.
HELPERHUB.JournalPinClick: Confirm, then left-click the map. Hold Shift to skip grid snapping.
HELPERHUB.JournalPinCompendium: A page in a compendium cannot be pinned. Copy the journal into the world first.
HELPERHUB.JournalPinNoScene: View a scene before placing a pin.
HELPERHUB.JournalPinCreateFailed: The pin could not be created.
HELPERHUB.StatusAnimationsHint: Animations play on this client only and can be turned off without affecting anyone else.
HELPERHUB.DiscordMenuHint: Mirror new messages from one Discord text channel into Foundry chat while this world is open. The bot token stays on this client and is not stored in the world.
HELPERHUB.DiscordIntentHint: The bot needs the Message Content intent in the Discord developer portal. It must be on the server and able to see the channel. Only new messages are posted. Channel history is not imported.
HELPERHUB.DiscordSaveFailed: The Discord settings could not be saved.
HELPERHUB.DiscordConnected: Connected. Choose a server and a channel.
HELPERHUB.DiscordConnectionRefused: Discord refused the bot connection. Check the bot token and the Message Content intent. Retrying has stopped.
HELPERHUB.NpcTokenNamesHint: When an NPC token is created on a scene, its name becomes a random adjective plus the creature name. The actor and the prototype token keep their names. Player characters keep their own names.
